proxy_explanation: gradient of perturbed sample loss; the optional harmful-context term builds the same FGSM perturbation on harmful-no-trigger prompts, still without triggered samples
score_formula: alpha * (clean_grad_mean + alpha_safe * safe_grad_mean) - beta * abs(proxy_grad_mean * cosine)
seed_scope: torch/python/transformers RNG for perturbation and scoring
